sections.heading: UK immigration advice you can rely on
sections.text:
Good UK immigration advice starts with an honest assessment. Before you spend money on a Home Office application, we look at your circumstances, explain which routes are open to you and what each needs, and tell you plainly if something stands in the way.

We’re a trading name of Unique Visa Services Ltd, regulated by the Immigration Advice Authority. You can check our registration on the IAA’s online register.

sections.heading: Changes to settlement in 2027
sections.text: The government plans to move most routes to Indefinite Leave to Remain from 5 to 10 years during 2027. If you qualify now or soon, it’s worth getting UK immigration advice early. [Read about the ILR changes](/ilr-changes-2026/).

faqs.a: Yes. UK Immigration Advisory is a trading name of Unique Visa Services Ltd, regulated by the Immigration Advice Authority (IAA), reference F200700144. You can check our registration on the IAA’s online register.

faqs.q: How much does a consultation cost?
faqs.a: We’ll confirm the consultation fee when you book, and agree any further fee in writing before we start work.

faqs.q: Can I count my trips abroad myself?
faqs.a: Yes, use our [absence calculator](/absence-calculator/) as a guide. Rules and exceptions vary by route, so we check your exact position at consultation.

faqs.q: Do you only help people in Manchester?
faqs.a: No. We give UK immigration advice to clients across the UK and overseas by phone, video call and email.
